entries.problem: Error E10: low water pressure or no water in the washing machine
entries.possibleCause: Low water pressure or no water supply to the washing machine.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the water tap. Check the accessible water inlet hose and inlet filter, and check the water pressure.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if E10 remains after the water supply, hose, filter, and water pressure have been checked.
evidenceToRequest: photo of error E10 on the display
description of the water tap and hose checks
description of the inlet filter check
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, ANZEIGEN DER FEHLER-CODES DER WASCHMASCHINE

entries.problem: Error E12: washing machine is overfilled
entries.possibleCause: The manual identifies the condition as overfilling.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the washing machine. Close the water supply if safe. Do not dismantle the appliance.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for E12 overfilling, especially if water is leaking or flooding is present.
evidenceToRequest: photo of error E12 on the display
photo or video of any visible water or leakage
description of when the overfill occurred
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, ANZEIGEN DER FEHLER-CODES DER WASCHMASCHINE

entries.problem: Error E21: water does not drain correctly
entries.possibleCause: The water is not draining correctly.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check the drain pump filter and the accessible drain hose as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if E21 remains after the pump filter and drain hose have been checked.
evidenceToRequest: photo of error E21 on the display
description of the pump filter and drain hose checks
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, ANZEIGEN DER FEHLER-CODES DER WASCHMASCHINE

entries.problem: Error E30: door does not lock after closing
entries.possibleCause: The washing machine door is not locking correctly after being closed. Clothing may be trapped in the door.
entries.safeUserCheck: Close the washing machine door and check that no clothing is trapped in the door.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if E30 remains after the door has been closed correctly and any trapped clothing has been removed.
evidenceToRequest: photo of error E30 on the display
photo of the door area if useful
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, ANZEIGEN DER FEHLER-CODES DER WASCHMASCHINE

entries.problem: Another error not listed as E10, E12, E21, or E30 is displayed
entries.possibleCause: The manual does not specify the cause for other errors.
entries.safeUserCheck: Try restarting the washing machine once.
entries.claimTrigger: Contact the service centre if the error remains after restarting.
evidenceToRequest: description of what happened before the error
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 30, ANZEIGEN DER FEHLER-CODES DER WASCHMASCHINE

entries.problem: OVL appears on the display
entries.possibleCause: The washing machine is overloaded.
entries.safeUserCheck: Remove excess laundry and restart the washing machine. Do not exceed the programme load limit.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if OVL clears after excess laundry is removed.

entries.problem: Washing machine does not work
entries.possibleCause: The manual directs the customer to check the water tap, water inlet filter, door, and Start/Pause control.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the water tap. Clean the accessible inlet filter. Close the washing machine door and press Start/Pause.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the washing machine still does not operate after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the control panel
description of the water tap and filter checks
description of the door and Start/Pause checks

entries.problem: Water is leaking from the washing machine
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that the water hose may not be connected correctly.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the washing machine and close the water supply if safe. Check the accessible water hose connection without dismantling the appliance.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for an active leak or flooding.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the leak
photo of the accessible hose connection
description of when the leak occurs

entries.problem: Laundry remains unusually wet in the drum
entries.possibleCause: The manual directs the customer to redistribute the laundry and clean the pump filter.
entries.safeUserCheck: Redistribute the laundry in the drum and clean the pump filter using the user-maintenance procedure in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if laundry remains unusually wet after redistribution and pump-filter cleaning.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the wet laundry after the cycle

entries.problem: Unpleasant smell comes from the drum
entries.possibleCause: The manual provides a self-cleaning cycle as the corrective action.
entries.safeUserCheck: Run the self-cleaning programme without laundry.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the abnormal odour continues after the self-cleaning programme.
evidenceToRequest: description of whether the self-cleaning programme was completed

entries.problem: Drum requires self-cleaning because of unpleasant odour
entries.possibleCause: The manual recommends self-cleaning when there is an unpleasant smell from the drum.
entries.safeUserCheck: Run the self-cleaning programme without laundry.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the normal self-cleaning action.

entries.problem: Water remains in the fabric-softener compartment
entries.possibleCause: The manual directs the customer to press the insert in the middle compartment into position.
entries.safeUserCheck: Press the insert in the middle detergent-drawer compartment firmly into position.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if water continues to remain in the compartment after the insert has been correctly positioned.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the water remaining in the compartment
photo of the middle drawer insert
description of the check already completed

entries.problem: Laundry is poorly rinsed
entries.possibleCause: Incorrect detergent dosage for the soil level and water hardness, or a dirty pump filter.
entries.safeUserCheck: Dose detergent according to the soil level, water hardness, and detergent manufacturer's instructions. Clean the pump filter.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if rinsing remains poor after correcting detergent dosage and cleaning the pump filter.
evidenceToRequest: photo of residue on the laundry

entries.problem: Washing machine does not fill with water
entries.possibleCause: The water tap may be closed, the selected programme may be incorrect, water pressure may be insufficient, the water hose may be connected incorrectly, the door may be open, or the hose may be kinked or blocked.
entries.safeUserCheck: Open the water tap. Check the programme setting and water pressure. Check that the accessible water hose is correctly connected and not kinked or blocked. Close the washing machine door.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the machine still does not fill after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the control panel
description of the water tap, pressure, hose, and door checks

entries.problem: Water enters and drains at the same time
entries.possibleCause: The end of the drain hose may be below the washing machine water level.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the drain-hose end is positioned above the water level and within the manual's stated height range of 0.6 m to 1 m.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if simultaneous filling and draining continues after the drain-hose position has been corrected.
evidenceToRequest: description of the drain-hose height check

entries.problem: Water does not drain correctly
entries.possibleCause: The pump filter, drain hose, or drain-hose installation may be causing the drainage problem.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check and clean the pump filter. Check the accessible drain hose and confirm that its outlet is positioned 0.6 m to 1 m above the floor.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if drainage remains incorrect after these checks.

entries.problem: Washing machine vibrates excessively
entries.possibleCause: Transport restraints may still be installed, the washing machine may not be level, or the feet may not be secured.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check that the transport restraints have been removed. Check that the washing machine is level and stable, and that the adjustable feet are secured.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if excessive vibration continues after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo showing the installation and floor
description of the transport-restraint and levelling checks

entries.problem: Excessive foam appears in the detergent drawer
entries.possibleCause: Too much detergent may have been used, or the detergent amount or type may not suit the water hardness and washing conditions.
entries.safeUserCheck: Reduce the amount of detergent. Check the water hardness, detergent amount, and detergent type used.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if excessive foaming continues despite correct detergent use.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the foam

entries.problem: Washing machine stops before the programme finishes
entries.possibleCause: The manual directs the customer to check the power supply and the water inlet and drainage.
entries.safeUserCheck: Check the normal power supply, water supply, and accessible drain path.
entries.claimTrigger: Create a service claim if the washing machine continues to stop before the programme ends after these checks.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video of the control panel when the machine stops
description of power, water-supply, and drainage checks

entries.problem: Drain pump makes a characteristic noise after water has been pumped out
entries.possibleCause: A small amount of water remains in the pump and drain pipe after the drum has been emptied. Continuous pump operation then draws in air and causes a characteristic noise.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required when the noise occurs only as described after draining.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for this normal pump noise alone.

entries.problem: Short pauses occur during the wash programme
entries.possibleCause: The machine may automatically add water, or the pause may occur while excessive foam is being reduced.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required for short pauses caused by automatic water filling or foam reduction.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for these normal short pauses alone.

entries.problem: Pump filter requires cleaning
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that neglecting pump-filter cleaning can cause difficulty draining water from the washing machine.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the washing machine from the power supply. Open the filter flap, remove the pump filter as shown in the manual, remove small foreign objects, and reinstall the filter in reverse order. The manual recommends cleaning it approximately every 20 washes.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal pump-filter cleaning. Create a claim if drainage problems continue after the filter has been correctly cleaned and reinstalled.
evidenceToRequest: description of whether drainage improved after cleaning
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 31, WARTUNG UND REINIGUNG - Reinigung des Pumpenfilters

entries.problem: Water inlet filter requires cleaning
entries.possibleCause: A dirty inlet filter can contribute to water-supply problems.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply. Unscrew the accessible water hose, remove the inlet filter screen as described in the manual, clean it with a brush, and reinstall it.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal inlet-filter cleaning. Create a claim if water-supply problems continue after cleaning.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the inlet filter condition
description of whether filling improved after cleaning
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 31, WARTUNG UND REINIGUNG - Reinigung des Wasserversorgungsventils

entries.problem: Current wash programme needs to be cancelled or changed
entries.possibleCause: The user may need to stop the current programme and select another programme.
entries.safeUserCheck: Press the Standby button to cancel the wash programme. Switch the washing machine on again, select the desired programme, and press Start/Pause.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal programme cancellation or changing.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 28, BESCHREIBUNG DER BENUTZUNG - Abbrechen und Wechsel des Waschprogramms

entries.problem: Power supply is interrupted during a wash programme
entries.possibleCause: A power failure or disconnection from the mains has interrupted operation.
entries.safeUserCheck: The selected programme is stored and resumes after power is restored. Do not open the washing machine door during a power failure.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if the programme resumes normally when power returns. Create a claim if the machine does not resume or operate correctly after power is restored.

entries.problem: Washing machine door will not open during or immediately after washing
entries.possibleCause: The door is locked during washing. It also remains locked when water is still in the drum or the temperature is too high.
entries.safeUserCheck: Wait for the programme to finish and for the door to unlock automatically. Do not force the door open.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required while the door is normally locked during washing or because water or temperature conditions prevent opening. Create a claim if the door remains locked after the programme has finished and safe conditions have returned.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the door-lock symbol or display if the door remains locked after the programme
description of whether water remains in the drum

entries.problem: Spin speed is reduced or spinning is skipped
entries.possibleCause: The load is distributed unevenly in the drum and the balance-control system cannot redistribute it sufficiently.
entries.safeUserCheck: After the programme ends, open the door, redistribute the laundry by hand, close the door, and select the spin programme again.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required if normal spinning resumes after redistributing the laundry. Create a claim if the issue repeatedly occurs with correctly distributed loads.
evidenceToRequest: description of whether redistribution solved the problem
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 34, KONTROLLE DER VERTEILUNG DES WASCHGUTS

entries.problem: Displayed remaining time changes, pauses, or jumps
entries.possibleCause: The displayed time is only an estimate and can change depending on temperature, water pressure, load size, detergent amount, and other washing conditions. Temporary freezing and time jumps are possible.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required if the programme continues operating normally.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for normal time adjustments alone.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 25, BESCHREIBUNG DER BEDIENFELDES UND DES DISPLAYS - Display

entries.problem: Display shows End and an audible signal sounds after washing
entries.possibleCause: The wash programme has finished. The audible signal sounds if the sound function is enabled.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for the normal End display or end-of-programme sound.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 28, BESCHREIBUNG DER BENUTZUNG - Ende des Waschprogramms

entries.problem: Power cable is damaged
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that a damaged or modified power cable can cause electric shock, short circuit, or fire due to overheating.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the washing machine. Disconnect it from the power supply only if this can be done safely. Do not repair or replace the cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for a damaged power cable or exposed electrical parts. Cable replacement must be carried out by authorised service or a qualified electrician.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged cable if safe to take
description of when it was noticed
entries.sourceSection: PDF pp. 10, 16 and 21, SICHERHEIT UND KENNZEICHNUNGEN AUF DEN PFLEGEETIKETTEN / Anschluss an die elektrische Speisung
